snapshots.title: Ahmedabad Institute of Technology — Placement Cell
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Placement — Cell
The objective of AIT Placement Cell is to reduce the gap between industry expectations and curriculum offered. At AIT, we provide placement assistance and guidance to students from the very first year. Customized training and grooming sessions are planned for each semester, supported by expert talks and mentoring sessions to help students choose better career options aligned with their strengths.
The Placement Cell conducts expert talks on psychometric tests, personality development, self-awareness, smart goals, and career management. Training sessions include resume writing, personal grooming, managing non-verbal communication, and mock interviews with video feedback to prepare students for real-world challenges.

snapshots.title: Principal’s Message – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content: Principal’s Message – R. C. Technical Institute Skip to content R. C. Technical Institute Principal’s Message Principal’s Message R. C. Technical Institute, the first and one of the oldest technical institutes of Gujarat, was established with the vision of Sir Ranchhodlal Chhotalal, a pioneering industrialist and educationist who laid the foundation of modern textile and technical education in Gujarat. His foresight continues to inspire us to blend tradition with innovation in shaping skilled professionals. Over the years, RCTI has evolved into a hub of technical learning that nurtures both competence and character. Our programs not only address the needs of industries and society but also provide students with a strong academic foundation for pursuing higher studies such as B.Tech and beyond. Experienced faculty, with their deep subject expertise, play a vital role in guiding students’ development. The institute’s approach seamlessly merges innovation with integrity, problem solving with passion and technology with community. Today, RCTI stands as an amalgamation of knowledge, skill, and values in technical education — empowering students to contribute to the progress of India while staying ready to face the challenges of a rapidly evolving world. – Principal R. C. Technical Institute

Technical Institute Facilities Student Section The prime objective of the student section is to assist the students for their various kinds of activities seeking from the institution. Student Section works for the students for following areas:- Scholarship Student Insurance Examination Mark Sheet Distribution Provisional Certificate ST/ Railway Concession Pass Bonafide Certificate Transcript, Migration related work Notify students about various activities For More details Click Here Library Total Books : 24787 Periodical / Journal : 31 News Papers : 03 Library has also developed e-Granthalaya facility for students and faculties. For more details Click Here Seminar Hall The institute’s Seminar Hall is a modern, fully air-conditioned facility with a seating capacity of approximately 150 people. Designed to host a variety of academic and institutional events, it is equipped with a large projection screen, high-quality projector, podium, tables, PA (Public Address) system, and a full audio-visual setup. This state-of-the-art facility serves as the venue for guest lectures, conferences, seminars, council meetings, debates, and various other academic events. It provides an ideal environment for meaningful discussions and interactive sessions, often featuring talks by distinguished speakers and professionals from diverse fields. Laboratories Each department at the institute is equipped with modern, well-maintained laboratories that support practical learning and hands-on experience. These labs are continuously upgraded and new facilities are developed in emerging areas of technology and research. The campus provides free internet access to all students and faculty members, ensuring seamless connectivity for academic and research purposes. RTO License Facilitation Center R. C. Technical Institute is equipped with an RTO (Regional Transport Office) License Facilitation Center within its campus. This center is set up in collaboration with the local transport authorities to assist in the application and processing of learning licenses and driving licenses. This initiative greatly benefits students and people nearby, especially those from outstation areas, by saving time and reducing the hassle of visiting external RTO offices.

C. Technical Institute Ranchhodlal Chhotalal Technical Institute (R C Technical Institute) was established in the memory of Shri Rao Bahadoor Ranchhodlal Chhotalal (The First Nagarpati and pioneer of textile industry in India) by his grandson Chinubhai Madhowlal Ranchhodlal, in the year 1910 at Saraspur, Ahmedabad Gujarat India. Later in the year 1930, this institute was handed over to the then State Government of Bombay. Initially, the institute was running certificate courses in Mechanical,Electrical,Textile Spinning,Textile Weaving and Textile Processing. In the year 1947, these certificate courses were replaced by new Diploma programmes in Textile Manufacturing and Textile Processing. Looking to the need of industries, the programs like Printing technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, IT Engineering, ICT Engineering & Civil etc. are added gradually. To accommodate this expansion in environmentally clean and layer area, the institute is shifted to the new campus at sola, Ahmedabad in June 1997. The institute functions as a Government of Gujarat institution under the administrative control of the Directorate of Technical Education, Gujarat State. It is affiliated to Gujarat Technological University and approved by AICTE. The institute offers nine diploma programmes in various engineering disciplines, of which four are accredited by the NBA. Admissions are granted based on 10th-grade merit through the state’s centralized diploma admission system. Vision To cater to the technological development of the nation through excellence in technical education by satisfying needs of the industries and society. Mission M1- To impart qualitative technical education to the students and inculcating core values in them through optimum utilization and mobilization of institute’s resources to enhance their employability. M2- To strengthen linkage with industry, networking with other institutions and organizations by providing various services and conducting demand driven continuing education and community program. M3- To strive for becoming a center of excellence enabling to face the ever changing and challenging technological environment. Departments @ RCTI Civil Engineering Computer Engineering Electrical Engineering ICT Information Technology Mechanical Engineering Applied Mechanics Printing Technology Textile Manufacturing Tech. Textile Processing Technology Science & Humanities

snapshots.title: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
Concrete technology lab In concrete technology lab we are conducting various tests on concrete ingredients like sand, cement and aggregate along with concrete to identify their suitability for various types of concrete construction and concrete structure. We can compute concrete mix proportions as per Indian Standard guidelines using this resource materials. Among major equipments, we have compression testing machine, concrete mixer, los angeles abrasion testing machine, impact testing machine, table vibrator, cement mortar vibrating machine, cube moulds, water tank, water bath and various other apparatus. Soil Engineering Lab For conducting various laboratory tests, among major equipments, we have standard proctor test apparatus, thermostatic oven, test sieves, accurate digital balance, Atterberg limits apparatus, field density measurement apparatus, box shear testing machine and pycnometer bottle and various other apparatus. Soil Engineering laboratory: a brief description Equipment For conducting various laboratory tests, among major equipments, we have box shear testing machine, thermostatic oven, test sieves, accurate digital balance, Atterberg limits apparatus, field density measurement apparatus, proctor density apparatus and pycnometer bottle and various other apparatus. Usage In soil mechanics lab, we are conducting various tests on soil to determine its various engineering properties and classify the soil as per Indian Standard. We can identify its suitability for various types of engineering structures. Importance The Soil Mechanics Laboratory is important for civil engineering and infrastructure development because it helps ensure structural stability and safety by providing data for foundation design.

snapshots.title: R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Welcome to R. C. Technical Institute
Ranchhodlal Chhotalal Technical Institute (R C Technical Institute) was established in the memory of Shri Rao Bahadoor Ranchhodlal Chhotalal (The First Nagarpati and pioneer of textile industry in India) by his grandson Chinubhai Madhowlal Ranchhodlal, in the year 1910 at Saraspur, Ahmedabad Gujarat India. Later in the year 1930, this institute was handed over to the then State Government of Bombay. Initially, the institute was running certificate courses in Mechanical,Electrical,Textile Spinning,Textile Weaving and Textile Processing.
In the year 1947, these certificate courses were replaced by new Diploma programmes in Textile Manufacturing and Textile Processing. Looking to the need of industries, the programs like Printing technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, IT Engineering, ICT Engineering & Civil etc. are added gradually. To accommodate this expansion in environmentally clean and layer area, the institute is shifted to the new campus at sola, Ahmedabad in June 1997.
The institute functions as a Government of Gujarat institution under the administrative control of the Directorate of Technical Education, Gujarat State. It is affiliated to Gujarat Technological University and approved by AICTE. The institute offers nine diploma programmes in various engineering disciplines, of which four are accredited by the NBA. Admissions are granted based on 10th-grade merit through the state’s centralized diploma admission system.

SECTION: Vision
To cater to the technological development of the nation through excellence in technical education by satisfying needs of the industries and society.

SECTION: Mission
M1- To impart qualitative technical education to the students and inculcating core values in them through optimum utilization and mobilization of institute’s resources to enhance their employability.
M2- To strengthen linkage with industry, networking with other institutions and organizations by providing various services and conducting demand driven continuing education and community program.
M3- To strive for becoming a center of excellence enabling to face the ever changing and challenging technological environment.

snapshots.title: Principal’s Message – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Principal’s Message
R. C. Technical Institute, the first and one of the oldest technical institutes of Gujarat, was established with the vision of Sir Ranchhodlal Chhotalal, a pioneering industrialist and educationist who laid the foundation of modern textile and technical education in Gujarat. His foresight continues to inspire us to blend tradition with innovation in shaping skilled professionals.
Over the years, RCTI has evolved into a hub of technical learning that nurtures both competence and character. Our programs not only address the needs of industries and society but also provide students with a strong academic foundation for pursuing higher studies such as B.Tech and beyond. Experienced faculty, with their deep subject expertise, play a vital role in guiding students’ development. The institute’s approach seamlessly merges innovation with integrity, problem solving with passion and technology with community.
Today, RCTI stands as an amalgamation of knowledge, skill, and values in technical education — empowering students to contribute to the progress of India while staying ready to face the challenges of a rapidly evolving world.
– Principal
R. C. Technical Institute

Student Section The prime objective of the student section is to assist the students for their various kinds of activities seeking from the institution. Student Section works for the students for following areas:- Scholarship Student Insurance Examination Mark Sheet Distribution Provisional Certificate ST/ Railway Concession Pass Bonafide Certificate Transcript, Migration related work Notify students about various activities For More details Click Here Library Total Books : 24787 Periodical / Journal : 31 News Papers : 03 Library has also developed e-Granthalaya facility for students and faculties. For more details Click Here Seminar Hall The institute’s Seminar Hall is a modern, fully air-conditioned facility with a seating capacity of approximately 150 people. Designed to host a variety of academic and institutional events, it is equipped with a large projection screen, high-quality projector, podium, tables, PA (Public Address) system, and a full audio-visual setup. This state-of-the-art facility serves as the venue for guest lectures, conferences, seminars, council meetings, debates, and various other academic events. It provides an ideal environment for meaningful discussions and interactive sessions, often featuring talks by distinguished speakers and professionals from diverse fields. Laboratories Each department at the institute is equipped with modern, well-maintained laboratories that support practical learning and hands-on experience. These labs are continuously upgraded and new facilities are developed in emerging areas of technology and research. The campus provides free internet access to all students and faculty members, ensuring seamless connectivity for academic and research purposes. RTO License Facilitation Center R. C. Technical Institute is equipped with an RTO (Regional Transport Office) License Facilitation Center within its campus. This center is set up in collaboration with the local transport authorities to assist in the application and processing of learning licenses and driving licenses. This initiative greatly benefits students and people nearby, especially those from outstation areas, by saving time and reducing the hassle of visiting external RTO offices.

snapshots.title: National Service Scheme (NSS) – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: National Service Scheme (NSS) – R. C. Technical Institute
About National Service Scheme (NSS) The National Service Scheme (NSS) is a Central Sector Scheme of Government of India, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports. It provides opportunity to the student youth of 11th & 12th Class of schools at +2 Board level and student youth of Technical Institution, Graduate & Post Graduate at colleges and University level of India to take part in various Government led community service activities & programmes. The primary objective of developing the personality and character of the student youth through voluntary community service. ‘Education through Service’ is the purpose of the NSS. NSS was launched in 1969 in 37 Universities involving about 40,000 volunteers which has now spread over 657 Universities and 51 +2 Councils/Directorates, covering 20,669 Colleges/ Technical Institutions and 11,988 Senior Secondary School. Since inception , over 7.4 crore students have benefitted from NSS. Motto: The motto of National Service Scheme is NOT ME BUT YOU .

snapshots.title: Applied Mechanics Department – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Applied Mechanics Department – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Applied Mechanics Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Smt. Bhruguli C. Shah The Applied Mechanics Deparment is mainly working with Civil Engineering Department & Mechanical Engineering Deparment. The Civil Engineering program has achieved NBA accreditation. The department is dedicated to promoting academic excellence and providing golden oppurtunities for campus placements with companies such as Adani, Torrent,power,, L&T etc. Vision Mission Prepare globally employable and competent civil engineers with core values ready to contribute for solving civil engineering challenges. M1: To impart quality education and introduce awareness of modern techniques to establish as acceptable civil engineers in the dynamic and challenging environment. M2: To inculcate soft-skills, team spirit, and professional ethics to render services for handling civil engineering works. M3: To prepare quality technocrats and professionals self-motivated to promote continuing education. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : Plan, design, and efficiently supervise construction as well as carry out maintenance of civil engineering works within estimated time and cost. PEO2 : Use of contemporary and innovative materials as well as advanced techniques for sustainable, eco-friendly infrastructures with optimal usage of resources. PEO3 : Inculcate the sense of rendering services with responsibility, safety, morality and team spirit. PEO4 : Motivate to continue lifetime education and take up challenging innovative projects. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PSO1 : Enhancing the employability skills in the field of surveying, planning, analyzing, designing, estimating, costing, testing as well as carrying out repairs and maintenance for all kind of civil engineering works. PSO2 : Apply modern construction techniques, equipment and management tools and use optimal resources so as to complete the project within estimated time and cost with safety and quality control. Program Outcomes: PO1 – “Engineering knowledge”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. PO2 – “Problem Analysis”: Identify and analyze well-defined engineering problems using codified standard methods. PO3 – “Design/development of solution”: Design solutions for well-defined technical problems and assist with the design of systems components or processes to meet specified needs. PO4 – “Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing”: Apply modern engineering tools and appropriate technique to conduct standard tests and measurements. PO5 – “Engineering Practices for society, Sustainability and Environment”: Apply appropriate technology in context of society, sustainability, environment and ethical practices. PO6 – “Project Management”: Use engineering management principles individually, as a team member or a leader to manage projects and effectively communicate about well-defined engineering activities. PO7 – “Life-long learning solution”: Ability to analyze individual needs and engage in updating in the context of technological changes. Facilities Applied Mechanics department is well-equipped with a variety of facilities to support student learning and practical experience. These facilities typically include: Laboratories: Soil Mechanics Lab: Enables the study of soil behaviour and its engineering properties, crucial for foundation design. Building Material Lab: Utilized for testing the properties of various construction materials like bricks, cement, concrete, and coarse and fine aggregates. Concrete Technology Lab: Dedicated to testing and analyzing key properties of concrete, including workability, strength, and durability.

Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : Plan, design, and efficiently supervise construction as well as carry out maintenance of civil engineering works within estimated time and cost. PEO2 : Use of contemporary and innovative materials as well as advanced techniques for sustainable, eco-friendly infrastructures with optimal usage of resources. PEO3 : Inculcate the sense of rendering services with responsibility, safety, morality and team spirit. PEO4 : Motivate to continue lifetime education and take up challenging innovative projects. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PSO1 : Enhancing the employability skills in the field of surveying, planning, analyzing, designing, estimating, costing, testing as well as carrying out repairs and maintenance for all kind of civil engineering works. PSO2 : Apply modern construction techniques, equipment and management tools and use optimal resources so as to complete the project within estimated time and cost with safety and quality control. Program Outcomes: PO1 – “Basic and Discipline knowledge”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. PO2 – “Problem Analysis”: Identify and analyze well-defined engineering problems using codified standard methods. PO3 – “Design/development of solution”: Design solutions for well-defined technical problems and assist with the design of systems components or processes to meet specified needs. PO4 – “Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing”: Apply modern engineering tools and appropriate technique to conduct standard tests and measurements. PO5 – “Engineering Practices for society, Sustainability and Environment”: Apply appropriate technology in context of society, sustainability, environment and ethical practices. PO6 – “Project Management”: Use engineering management principles individually, as a team member or a leader to manage projects and effectively communicate about well-defined engineering activities. PO7 – “Life-long learning solution”: Ability to analyze individual needs and engage in updating in the context of technological changes. Facilities Civil Engineering departments are well-equipped with a variety of facilities to support student learning and practical experience. These facilities typically include: Specialized Laboratories: – Transportation Engineering Lab: Used for testing the properties of highway materials like aggregates and bitumen. – Hydraulics Lab: Provides opportunities to study hydraulic systems and devices. – Surveying Lab: Focuses on practical training with modern surveying instruments like total stations and Electronic Theodolite. – Soil Mechanics Lab: Enables the study of soil behavior and its engineering properties, crucial for foundation design. – Building Material Lab: Utilized for testing the properties of various construction materials like bricks, cement, concrete, coarse and fine aggregates. – Concrete Technology Lab:  Dedicated to testing and analyzing key properties of concrete, including workability, strength, and durability. – Computer Lab (CAD Lab): Computer Lab (CAD Lab) is a dedicated facility equipped with high-performance computers and specialized software. It offers students and faculty access to essential tools, including an LCD projector and a white screen board, along with internet facilities to support learning, research, and collaborative projects. Libraries with relevant resources: – Departmental Library:  The departmental library for Civil Engineering serves as a specialized knowledge hub, offering a diverse collection of resources to support both academic and research pursuits within the discipline. A departmental library for Civil Engineering is expected to house a substantially larger collection more than 250 books to adequately support the diverse needs of the curriculum, faculty research, and student learning across various course levels.

snapshots.title: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
Hydraulics Laboratory Hydraulics consists of the application of fluid mechanics to water flowing in a pipe or in an open channel. The laboratory is designed to examine the properties of fluids and to conduct experiments involving both incompressible and compressible flow. Hydraulics laboratory is developed with the aim to develop different types of skills so that students are able to measure the flow of water in different conditions using various measuring devices and to compute discharge and loss of head through pipes, open channels, notches and other hydraulic structures. Major apparatus or equipments include Hydraulic Bench, Bernoulli’s Apparatus, Venturimeter, Rectangular and Triangular Notch Apparatus, Pipe friction Apparatus, Pitot tube Apparatus and Reynold’s number Apparatus. Water Supply & Sanitary Lab The Water Supply & Sanitary Engineering Laboratory, also known as the Environmental Engineering Laboratory or Public Health Engineering Laboratory, is a crucial facility dedicated to the study, analysis, and treatment of normal water and wastewater. It plays a pivotal role in ensuring public health and environmental sustainability. Equipment The laboratory is equipped with a wide range of instruments for analyzing various parameters in normal water, wastewater, and soil samples. Some of the key equipment include: – pH Meter: Measures the acidity or alkalinity of water samples. – Turbidity Meter (Nephelometer): Measures the cloudiness or haziness of water caused by suspended particles. – BOD Incubator & COD Digester: Used for measuring Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) and Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), which are indicators of organic pollution in water and wastewater. Usage The Water Supply & Sanitary Engineering Lab is utilized for various activities: – Water Quality Monitoring: Assessing the physical, chemical, and biological characteristics of drinking water, surface water, and groundwater to ensure it meets quality standards. – Wastewater Analysis: Analyzing domestic and industrial wastewater to determine pollutant levels and effectiveness of treatment processes. – Water Treatment Process Optimization: Conducting experiments to determine the optimal conditions for different water treatment processes like coagulation, filtration, and disinfection. Basic Transportation Engineering Laboratory In basic transportation lab, we are conducting various tests on various materials used in the construction work that can be used for a given transportation system. We are conducting various tests on aggregate, bitumen for determining their suitability for the construction work that can be used for a given transportation system. Among major equipments , we have compression testing machine, los angeles abrasion testing machine, impact testing machine, penetrometer, CBR test apparatus, pensky martin apparatus, ring and ball apparatus. Computer Laboratory In computer lab, boasts high-configuration desktop PCs and a reliable internet connection, along with printing and scanning facilities. A movable LCD projector with a dedicated laptop is available for presentations and demonstrations, and a licensed version of AutoCAD 2021 is utilized for design and drafting. In computer lab students develop various types of plans, elevations and interior drawings of civil engineering. Students can generate drawings of residential and commercial buildings by using various 2D and 3D Auto CAD commands. Concrete Technology Lab In concrete technology lab we are conducting various tests on concrete ingredients like sand, cement and aggregate along with concrete to identify their suitability for various types of concrete construction and concrete structure. We can compute concrete mix proportions as per Indian Standard guidelines using this resource materials. Among major equipments, we have compression testing machine, concrete mixer, los angeles abrasion testing machine, impact testing machine, table vibrator, cement mortar vibrating machine, cube moulds, water tank, water bath and various other apparatus. Soil Mechanics Lab For conducting various laboratory tests, among major equipments, we have box shear testing machine, thermostatic oven, test sieves, accurate digital balance, Atterberg limits apparatus, field density measurement apparatus, proctor density apparatus and pycnometer bottle and various other apparatus. Equipments For conducting various laboratory tests, among major equipments, we have box shear testing machine, thermostatic oven, test sieves, accurate digital balance, Atterberg limits apparatus, field density measurement apparatus, proctor density apparatus and pycnometer bottle and various other apparatus. Usage In soil mechanics lab, we are conducting various tests on soil to determine its various engineering properties and classify the soil as per Indian Standard. We can identify its suitability for various types of engineering structures. Importance The Soil Mechanics Laboratory is important for civil engineering and infrastructure development because it helps ensure structural stability and safety by providing data for foundation design.

In R.C.Technical Institute, Computer Department is established in the year of 2000 . Here we use learning tools like lecture-cum-discussions, laboratory works, tutorials, home assignments, seminars, field visits, finishing school trainings and project works to effectively teach curriculum designed by GTU. The department has well qualified faculties to cater the academic and other kinds of students’ needs. Department possesses classrooms and prime laboratories for language programming, database designing and networking as per AICTE norms and standards. We offer Interactive and effective learning environment to the students. Vision Mission To mould young and fresh minds into challenging computer professionals with ethical values and shaping them with upcoming technologies and develop the ability to deal with real world situations with skills and innovative ideas. M1: To produce competent computer professionals by providing state-of-the-art training, hands-on experience and skill for practical environment. M2: To impart moral, ethical values and interpersonal skills to the students. M3: To impart necessary technical and professional skills among the students to make them employable and eligible for higher studies. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : To solve real-life problems through the use of technical knowledge with attention to Team work, Effective Communication, Critical Thinking and Problem Solving skills. PEO2 : To demonstrate the ability to adapt to a dynamically changing technological environment by learning and applying new skills and technologies with ethical and legal responsibilities to the society as a whole. PEO3 : To make the students prepare for pursuing higher studies. PSO2 : Ability to advance with the evolutionary changes in technology that helps in successful job career, entrepreneurship and higher studies. PSO3 : Ability to understand, analyze and develop computer programs related to algorithm, system software, database, web design and networking. snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Department of Printing Technology – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Printing Technology Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Mr. D. D. Raval Start Year 1970 Intake 30 At present, this is only one Institute in Gujarat which conducting a 3 years Diploma Course in Printing Technology, under Directorate of Technical Education and affiliated to Gujarat Technological University. Aim of this course is to churn out skilled hands and technicians needed by the printing industry. It has all the facilities including workshop with all pre-press, press & post-press machinery, testing labs, library, class-rooms etc. An influential number of students as skilled personnel have been absorbed by the Printing, Packaging, Newspaper and Graphic Art’s industry & they are placed in different organizations and have contributed to their growth. Vision Mission To provide excellence knowledge and enrich the problem-solving skills of the students in the field of Printing Technology with a focus to prepare the students for industry need, recognized as innovative leader, responsible citizen and improve the environment. M1: To offer specialized Academic and Skill Development Programs in the field of Printing Technology for fulfilling the dynamic needs of Industry and Society. M2: To enhance the skills of entrepreneurship, innovativeness, management and life-long learning in young engineers. M3: To prepare them for successful employment in industry. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : Solving problems of Printing and core industries by applying skill and knowledge. PEO2 : Develop ethical value to an organization as professionals in teams and in lead roles. PEO3 : Establish state of art industries and able create the jobs. PEO4 : To be responsible members and leaders of their communities, understand the human, social and environmental context of their profession and contribute positively. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PSO1 : Identify and solve the complex printing problems by applying the skill and knowledge of process as well as various variables involved in respective printing process. PSO2 : Design and develop the product and process by the need of the industries and society. PSO3 : Analyse and improve productivity, quality and cost effectiveness for the various pre-press, press and post press process involved in printing to meet the industries requirement. Program Outcomes: PO1 – “Basic and Discipline specific Knowledge:”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. PO2 – “Problem Analysis”: Identify and analyse well-defined engineering problems using codified standard methods. PO3 – “Design/development of solution”: Design solutions for well-defined technical problems and assist with the design of systems components or processes to meet specified needs. PO4 – “Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing”: Apply modern engineering tools and appropriate technique to conduct standard tests and measurements. PO5 – “Engineering Practices for society, Sustainability and Environment”: Apply appropriate technology in context of society, sustainability, environment and ethical practices. PO6 – “Project Management”: Use engineering management principles individually, as a team member or a leader to manage projects and effectively communicate about well-defined engineering activities. PO7 – “Life-long learning solution”: Ability to analyze individual needs and engage in updating in the context of technological changes. Facilities – Lab – Classrooms – High Speed Internet

snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Department of Textile Manufacturing Technology – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Textile Manufacturing Technology Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Mr. S. M. Zala Start Year 1947 Intake 30 Textile Manufacturing Technology Department established in 1947, is one of the esteemed department of R.C. Technical Institute, Ahmedabad. Institute is running under Department of Technical Education, Government of Gujarat. Diploma in Textile Manufacturing Technology program is approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi and is affiliated to Gujarat Technological University, Ahmedabad. Textile Manufacturing Technology is a branch of engineering which deals with designing and manufacturing of apparel garments and functional fabrics. The textile industry is one of the oldest and the most widespread industries in Ahmedabad. Day by day textile industries upgraded technically & therefore to fulfil the requirement of technical people are essential. The department has qualified faculty members engaged in teaching learning process with the aim of achieving excellence in the field of Textile engineering. Vision Mission The department of Textile Manufacturing Technology is pioneer department of this institute for technical education knowledge and services, striving continuously for providing its excellence to the society and textile industry’s needs. M1: To develop students as competent technicians with required skills to serve the needs of textile industry and society. M2: To prepare students to hold leadership responsibilities in textile and related segments such as product development, production, technical services, quality assurance and marketing. M3: To impart qualitative technical education to students to understand the managerial responsibilities related to issues such as social, ethical, and environmental aspects of the textile industry. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : To gain knowledge of basic and modern technology in Textile manufacturing like Spinning ,Weaving, Knitting, Testing, Manmade fibre production, Garment manufacturing processes ,Development of Woven and Knitted designs. PEO2 : To lead the team for targeted production work and observe and maintain safety and control of the shop floor activities. PEO3 : To provide assistance to improve productivity and profitability by application of modern techniques. PEO4 : To pursue for higher studies or become successful entrepreneur in Textile and related field and contributing to societal, technological and industry development. Spinning Lab A Spinning Laboratory is textile laboratory designed for studying and analyzing the conversion of textile fibers into yarn. It is widely used in textile manufacturing education to understand spinning methods, yarn production processes, machine operations and the evaluation of yarn quality characteristics. Textile Testing Lab A Textile Testing Laboratory is used to test and evaluate the physical and mechanical properties of fibers, yarns, and fabrics. It is widely used in textile industries and educational institutes to ensure product quality, performance, and compliance with standard specifications. Fabric Structure Lab A Fabric Structure Laboratory is used for the study, analysis, and development of various fabric constructions. It is primarily utilized in textile manufacturing programs to examine the interlacement of yarns in woven fabrics, as well as to evaluate their structural characteristics and performance properties. snapshots.title: Department of Textile Processing Technology – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Department of Textile Processing Technology – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Textile Processing Technology Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Dr. R. D. Joshi Start Year 1947 Intake 30 The Textile Processing Department at R C Technical Institute, Ahmedabad, is one of the oldest departments of the institute. The passed-out students are the most sought after by reputed textiles and allied industries. All faculty members of department hold PhD. The department is set with well-equipped laboratories for various courses like textile chemistry, chemical processing, quality control and technical textile. It also has smart classroom with a smart board donated by the Textile Association (India), Ahmedabad Unit, for digital learning of students. The smart class room is also housing some advanced technical textile testing instruments donated by Inspiron Engineering Pvt. Ltd., Ahmedabad. The department is having strong liaison with textile and allied industries, resulting in total placements of all students. Vision Mission To impart quality technical education in Textile Processing to prepare competent, innovative, and industry-ready professionals for the textile sector and society. M1: Provide quality education in Textile Processing with a focus on sustainable and advanced textile technologies to address real-world industry challenges. M2: Enhance students technical competency in dyeing, printing, finishing, and quality control through state of the art laboratories, research orientation, and strong industry institute collaboration. M3: Instill professional ethics, creativity, and environmental responsibility in students to nurture globally competent textile technologists. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1: Diploma holders will apply their knowledge of textile materials and processing techniques in industries for product development, innovation, and sustainable solutions. PEO2: To prepare competent textile technologists capable of identifying, formulating, and solving practical problems in dyeing, printing, finishing, and quality control to meet the needs of industries and society. PEO3: To develop professional skills, technical expertise, and ethical values that prepare students for immediate employment and lifelong learning in the textile sector. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PSO1: The Textile Processing Diploma holder will be able to provide effective solutions to challenges in dyeing, printing, and finishing by using appropriate chemical processes, modern machinery, and sustainable technologies. PSO2: The Textile Processing Diploma holder will be able to apply technical knowledge, laboratory skills, and professional expertise for real-time operations in production, quality control, and process optimization within textile industries. Program Outcomes: PO1:  Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, science, and textile engineering fundamentals to solve problems related to textile materials and processing. PO2: Problem Analysis: Identify and analyze well-defined technical problems in textile processing using standard methods and practices. PO3: Design/Development of Solutions: Design solutions for practical textile processing challenges and assist in the development of processes, components, or systems to meet specified needs. PO4: Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing: Apply modern textile testing tools and techniques to conduct experiments, analyze data, and perform standard tests for dyeing, printing, finishing, and quality control. PO5: Engineering Practices for Society, Sustainability and Environment: Apply appropriate textile technologies considering sustainability, environmental impact, and ethical practices to benefit industry and society. PO6: Project Management: Use engineering and management principles effectively as an individual, team member, or leader to manage textile projects and communicate technical activities clearly. PO7: Life-long Learning: Recognize the need for continuous learning and acquire skills to adapt to technological advancements in textile processing and related fields. Facilities Classrooms with smart board, well- equipped Laboratories, hostel facility for both girls and boys.

snapshots.title: Electrical Engineering Department – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Electrical Engineering Department – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Electrical Engineering Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Ms. Alpa A. Amin Start Year 1990 Intake 240 (Regular) 30 (Working Professional) The Founded under the rich heritage of R.C. Technical Institute—established by Rao Bahadoor Ranchhodlal Chhotalal in 1910—the Electrical Engineering Department is located on the modern Sola campus, relocated in 1997 to support its evolving academic offerings. The department offers a robust three-year full-time diploma in Electrical Engineering , with intake of 240 Regular students and additional 30 seats are offered for working professionals who wish to enhance their qualifications alongside employment. Our focus lies in delivering quality technical education and nurturing well-rounded professionals . To achieve this, we organize Techfest, expert lectures, workshops, seminars and industrial visits , ensuring students stay aligned with the latest industry innovations and trends. The department is led by a team of well-qualified and experienced faculty , with the majority holding postgraduate (Master’s) degrees . It has been NBA accredited and re-accredited , reflecting its ongoing commitment to quality education and institutional growth. Our dedicated faculty guide students through academic and personal growth, offering individual counseling and comprehensive support . The department is equipped with advanced laboratories including AC Machine, DC Machine, Electrical Circuits & Instrumentation, Power Electronics, Switchgear & Protection, Digital Electronics & Microprocessor, and Computer Labs. The department also has state of art labs including project and industry supported lab. Placing a high value on career readiness, placement opportunities are facilitated, helping Students Bridge the gap between academics and industry— ensuring readiness for successful professional paths, including preparing students for higher studies in case they opt for the same. Vision Mission To impart quality education to prepare competent Electrical Engineers with high moral values. M1: To provide quality education through progressive learning environment. M2: To infuse technical competencies by enriching their problem solving skills. M3: To inculcate professional ethics and leadership qualities for employability, Start-ups and Entrepreneurship. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : Manage own Electrical Engineering enterprise. PEO2 : Develop proficiency in maintaining various Electrical equipments. PEO3 : Adapt the changing technologies to solve the Electrical Engineering problem for societal needs. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PSO1 : Maintain various types of electrical equipment and drives. PSO2 : Maintain the operation of power systems. PSO2 : Undertake the electrification of commercial and multistoried buildings. Program Outcomes: PO1 – “Basic and Discipline specific knowledge”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. PO2 – “Problem Analysis”: Identify and analyze well-defined engineering problems using codified standard methods. PO3 – “Design/development of solution”: Design solutions for well-defined technical problems and assist with the design of systems components or processes to meet specified needs. PO4 – “Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing”: Apply modern engineering tools and appropriate technique to conduct standard tests and measurements. PO5 – “Engineering Practices for society, Sustainability and Environment”: Apply appropriate technology in context of society, sustainability, environment and ethical practices. PO6 – “Project Management”: Use engineering management principles individually, as a team member or a leader to manage projects and effectively communicate about well-defined engineering activities. PO7 – “Life-long learning solution”: Ability to analyze individual needs and engage in updating in the context of technological changes. Facilities The Electrical Engineering Department at RCTI, Ahmedabad, offers a vibrant learning environment supported by advanced infrastructure, modern laboratories, and highly qualified faculty. Well-Equipped Laboratories Our department houses a comprehensive range of laboratories, each equipped with modern instruments and machines to provide practical, hands-on learning: * AC Machines Laboratory * DC Machines  Laboratory * Electrical Machines Laboratory * Basic Electronics Laboratory * Digital Electronics Laboratory * Power Electronics Laboratory * Project Laboratory * Electrical Measurement & Instrumentation Laboratory * Switchgear & Protection Laboratory * Microprocessor & Controller Laboratory * Computer Laboratory * Power System Laboratory All laboratories are maintained with the latest equipment, ensuring students gain industry-relevant skills. Additionally, we have a state-of-the-art, industry-supported laboratory to expose students to real-world industrial practices. Qualified and Dedicated Faculty The department is led by a team of dedicated faculty members, including: * 2 faculty members with Doctorate degrees * 4 faculty members currently pursuing Ph.D. * The majority of remaining faculty holding Master’s degrees Our faculty members are committed to providing quality education and continuous guidance to students. Holistic Development and Career Support We focus on the all-round development of our students by organizing: * Training and placement activities * Mock interviews and group discussions * Resume-building workshops * Industrial visits, workshops, and expert sessions to bridge the gap between industry and academia * Career and higher education mentoring Industry and Alumni Connect We maintain a strong alumni network, which actively supports our students in career building and networking. Regular interactions with alumni and industry experts enrich the learning experience. Beyond Academics The department also encourages participation in extra-curricular and co-curricular activities , ensuring the overall personality development of students.

snapshots.title: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
AC Machines Lab (Main Building 019) Equipments: Alternators (single-phase & three-phase), squirrel cage and slip-ring induction motors, synchronous motors, energy-efficient motors, transformers (single-phase & three-phase), and advanced measuring instruments. Usage: Facilitates experiments on performance, control, and testing of AC machines under various load and excitation conditions. Importance: Builds practical understanding of machine operation, efficiency, and characteristics essential for power generation and industrial drives. DC Machines Lab ( Main Building 018 ) Major Equipment s:  DC shunt, series, and compound wound motors; DC generators; motor-generator sets; electrical rotating machine trainers. Usage: Enables performance testing, load analysis, and efficiency evaluation of DC machines. Importance: Strengthens concepts of electromechanical energy conversion, motor control, and its different applications in the field of electrical engineering. Switch Gear and Protection Lab (Main Building 112) Equipment s:  Overcurrent relays, earth fault relays, static relays, Numerical relay and relay testing kits. Usage: Used for testing, calibration, and performance analysis of protection devices for power systems. Importance: Equips students with skills in fault detection, system protection, and safety, crucial for power network reliability. Electrical Measurement & Instrumentation Lab (Main Building 117) Equipments: Different Bridge Circuits for Measuring R,L,C Values, LVDT, Digital Calibration kit for Instruments Usage: Supports experiments on electrical measurements and industrial measurements and instrumentation . Importance : Develops accuracy in measurement, data acquisition, and control system understanding for process industries. Electronics Lab (Main Building 016) Equipments: Power electronics trainers kits for performing different practical’s, (Four Quadrant Chopper, converters, Cyclo converters), analog and digital trainer  kits, oscilloscope-based testing setups, DSOs, Kits for performing different practical’s for basic Electronics Usage: Covers experiments in rectifiers, inverters, choppers, and electronic control circuits, basic electronics and digital electronics performances. Importance: Essential for learning basic electronic circuits, digital electronic applications and power electronics circuits and applications. Circuit Lab Equipments: AC and DC circuit trainers, resistive, inductive, and capacitive load setups, single-phase and three-phase supply systems, measuring instruments (multimeters, wattmeters, ammeters, voltmeters). Usage: Enables students to perform experiments on Ohm’s law, network theorems, resonance, power factor improvement, and analysis of AC/DC circuits. Importance: Strengthens the foundational understanding of electrical circuit behavior, measurement techniques, and analytical skills essential for advanced electrical engineering studies. Electrical Workshop Lab Equipment: Tools for wiring, installation, and maintenance; electrician’s kits. Usage : Practical training in domestic and industrial wiring, motor installation, and fault diagnosis. Importance: Prepares students for hands-on electrical installation, Maintenance work and safety practices. Micro Processor Lab Equipment: 8085 microprocessor kits, 8051 microcontroller kits, Arduino controllers. Usage: Used for programming, interfacing, and practical system applications. Importance: Develops skills for micro-processor, microcontroller-based programming and their applications. Computer Lab Equipment: Networked PCs, software’s like MATLAB, PSIM and CAD tools. Usage: Understanding basic computer applications, Supports simulation, modeling, and design of electrical systems. Importance: Enhances computer skills for different applications in electrical engineering. Project Lab Equipment : Fabrication and testing tools, Oscilloscopes, DMM, PC system, Power Supply, Function generators, for Prototyping and circuit construction breadboards, soldering irons etc. Usage: Dedicated space for final-year projects, innovations, and startup ideas. Importance: Fosters creativity, innovation, and problem-solving through real-world project execution.

snapshots.title: Information And Communication Technology – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Information And Communication Technology – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Information & Communication Technology Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Ms. Varsha R. Bhatt Start Year 2022 Intake 30 Information and Communication Technology (ICT) is an emerging branch of diploma which is newly introduced in year 2022 by Government of Gujrat in order to keep pace with the latest development in industries through application areas like cloud computing, data science, embedded systems, IOT, cyber securities, open source software design and development tools etc. This program is in line with New Education Policy 2020 (NEP2020). Information and Communication Technology is used in telecommunication, broadcast media, intelligent information creation and management system, audio visual processing, transmission systems, network controlling and monitoring etc. Student learns in depth during three years diploma study about these software and hardware application areas through various fundamental and application level courses using outcome based education approach. This enables the students to become competent for the present and future challenges of information and communication. Vision Mission Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) Program Outcomes: PO1 – “Engineering knowledge”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. PO2 – “Problem Analysis”: Identify and analyze well-defined engineering problems using codified standard methods. PO3 – “Design/development of solution”: Design solutions for well-defined technical problems and assist with the design of systems components or processes to meet specified needs. PO4 – “Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing”: Apply modern engineering tools and appropriate technique to conduct standard tests and measurements. PO5 – “Engineering Practices for society, Sustainability and Environment”: Apply appropriate technology in context of society, sustainability, environment and ethical practices. PO6 – “Project Management”: Use engineering management principles individually, as a team member or a leader to manage projects and effectively communicate about well-defined engineering activities. PO7 – “Life-long learning solution”: Ability to analyze individual needs and engage in updating in the context of technological changes. Facilities – Computer Laboratory – Electronics Laboratory – Departmental Library – Sports Activity

snapshots.title: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
Electronics Lab (ICT 101) Electronics Lab focuses on the skills of designing, developing, and testing wide range of electronic circuits using test and measuring instruments like cathode ray oscilloscopes, function generators, digital multimeters etc. In this lab, the students will be able to carry out the experiments and analyze the electronic circuits such as rectifiers, diodes, amplifiers. Digital Electronic Circuits Lab will enable the undergraduate students to learn the basic concepts and techniques in digital electronic circuits.The learning objective of this laboratory is to supplement the theory course of digital electronic circuits with adequate introduction to both combinatorial and sequential logic circuits, such as, adders, subtractors, comparator, multiplexer/DE multiplexer,encoders/decoders, 7-segment display and decoder/driver, flip-flop, register, counter, etc.and various combinations of these. Instruments: Oscilloscope ,Function Generator, Digital Multimeter, DC Power Supply and Digital trainer Kits , Electroincs trainer kits Communication Lab 2 (ICT-106) Communication laboratory focuses on training the students in both Digital and analog communication. This laboratory provides hands-on practical training in the diversified fields of Analog & Digital Modulation Techniques. The students are trained for constructing the Circuits of different communication techniques like Filters, Attenuators. Basic Laboratory Instruments: Analog Modulation trainer kit, Digital Modulation Trainer Kit, CRO, Power Supplies, Function Generator Programming Lab-1 (ICT-102) The lab is used by the students to interface the microprocessor and microcontroller to various peripheral devices to generate waveforms, perform A/D and D/A conversions, Keyboard and Display Interface, Stepper motor Interface, DC Motor Speed Control. Programming Lab-2-ICT105 The Programming Language – I lab serves focusing on subjects such as Object-Oriented Programming in Java, Web Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms. It is primarily utilized for hands-on practical sessions covering various programming languages like Java, Python, and several web programming languages.

Technical Institute was established in 2007 with an initial intake of 60 students. Currently, it has an intake capacity of 180 students. The department has 20 well-qualified, motivated, and dedicated faculty members, and it aims to develop globally competent IT professionals with strong technical knowledge and ethical values. It is equipped with well-furnished computer laboratories featuring advanced systems and high-speed internet facilities. Vision Mission To impart quality technical education to prepare competent professionals for industry and society. M1: Provide quality education in Information Technology to solve real world problems. M3: Impart ethical values in IT engineer to become a responsible member of workforce and society. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : Diploma holder will apply their knowledge in Engineering applications / industries for development as well as innovation in the industries. PEO2 : To make them competent IT professionals to identify, formulate, and solve challenging IT problems to meet the needs of industries and society. PEO3 : To develop professional skills to prepare them for immediate employment. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PSO1 : The IT Engineer will be able to provide specific solutions to problems in software domain with Use of engineering tools and technology PSO2 : The IT Engineer will be able to apply knowledge, techniques and professional skills for real time operation to develop an application and maintenance of computer hardware and networking. Program Outcomes: PO1 – “Engineering knowledge”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. snapshots.title: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Labs – R. C. Technical Institute
Advanced Programming Lab-1 (TB-209) A beginner-level lab focusing on foundational programming and logical thinking. Students write basic programs using languages like Python. They learn syntax, control structures, loops, arrays, and functions. Emphasis is placed on algorithm development, debugging, and structured coding practices. This lab builds confidence for advanced programming tasks. Advanced Programming Lab-2 (TB-210) This lab introduces object-oriented programming concepts such as classes, objects, inheritance, and polymorphism. Languages like Java are used for implementation. Students work on mini projects to reinforce concepts and develop modular, reusable code. The lab fosters deeper understanding of software development methodologies and OOP design patterns. Mobile Computing and Networking Lab (TB-216) This lab provides practical skills in assembling, maintaining, and troubleshooting computer hardware. Students learn to configure BIOS, install OS, and manage peripheral devices. On the networking side, they configure IP addresses, set up LANs, and simulate network topologies using tools like Cisco Packet Tracer. It bridges theory and real-world IT infrastructure knowledge. Database and Web Development Lab (TB-115) An advanced programming lab focusing on data structures, algorithms, and file operations. Students implement stacks, queues, linked lists, and sorting/searching algorithms. The lab also introduces memory management and recursion. Coding practices are reinforced through assignments and problem-solving activities, enhancing analytical and logical skills. Programming Lab-1 (TB-203) This lab enables students to conceptualize and implement small-scale projects based on computer system principles. It encourages innovation through problem identification, system design, and coding. Students gain exposure to version control, testing techniques, and structured documentation. The lab promotes teamwork, time management, and presentation skills, simulating an industry project environment. Programming Lab-2 (TB-206) This introductory lab focuses on frontend web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Students design static and interactive web pages using best UI/UX practices. They learn page layout, forms, styling, and responsive design principles. This lab builds the foundation for advanced web development and serves as a gateway to full-stack projects. Project Lab (TB-207) This advanced lab covers full-stack web development using modern frameworks and tools. Students build dynamic web applications involving frontend, backend, and databases. They gain hands-on experience with technologies like PHP. The lab also emphasizes responsive design, user authentication, and deployment. Team projects and real-time collaboration are encouraged.

snapshots.title: Mechanical Engineering Department – R. C. Technical Institute
snapshots.text_content:
SECTION: Mechanical Engineering Department – R. C. Technical Institute
Programme Diploma in Mechanical Engineering Duration 3 Years (Full Time) Head of Department Shri G. R. Khunt Start Year 1990 Intake 240 (Regular) 30 (Working Professionals) Established in 1986 under the Commissionerate of Technical Education, Gujarat State, the Mechanical Engineering Department at R. C. Technical Institute (RCTI) is a pioneer and well-reputed department, recognized across the state for its quality education and industry-oriented training. With a sanctioned intake of 240 students, the department is strategically located in Ahmedabad, enabling strong industrial connectivity and offering students excellent exposure and opportunities. The Mechanical Engineering Department is equipped with a wide range of state-of-the-art laboratories and workshops, including: Workshop Fitting Shop Carpentry Shop Machine Shop CAD/CAM Laboratory Metrology and Instrumentation Laboratory Thermal Engineering Laboratory Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machines Laboratory Theory of Machines and Mechanisms Laboratory Design of Machine Elements Laboratory These facilities support comprehensive hands-on training and foster technical expertise among students. The Mechanical Engineering Department is supported by a highly qualified faculty team comprising 32 members, including 4 Ph.D. holders and 27 postgraduate (M.E.) degree holders, ensuring a strong academic and research foundation. The department consistently achieves a high placement rate through its proactive Training & Placement Cell, enabling students to secure positions in reputed industries and pursue higher education opportunities. In addition to academic excellence, the department emphasizes holistic student development by encouraging active participation in technical and non-technical events at both state and university levels. It also fosters a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship through initiatives such as the Student Start-up and Innovation Policy (SSIP). Vision Mission To provide quality education in mechanical engineering and develop skilled professionals with lifelong learning, technical knowledge and ethical values to serve industry and society. M1: To provide students with mechanical engineering knowledge and skills to make them technically competent and self-reliant. M2: To encourage students for higher technical education and prepare them as ethical and responsible professionals for industry and society. M3: To support overall student development through industry interaction, teamwork and extracurricular activities. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) PEO1 : To apply fundamental engineering knowledge and technical skills to solve real-world problems in a professional environment. PEO2 : To plan, operate and manage engineering activities using appropriate tools, equipment and techniques. PEO3 : To demonstrate leadership, teamwork and responsibility in professional and project based settings. Program Specific Outcome (PSOs) PS01: Able to apply principles of mathematics, science, fluid mechanics and Thermal engineering to design, manufacture, estimate the cost and maintain the machine or machine elements in industries and society. PSO2: Able to communicate, lead and can generate employability with high   standard of integrity and ethics. Program Outcomes: PO1 – “ Basic and Discipline specific knowledge: ”: Apply knowledge of basic mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals and engineering specialization to solve the engineering problems. PO2 – “Problem Analysis”: Identify and analyze well-defined engineering problems using codified standard methods. PO3 – “Design/development of solution”: Design solutions for well-defined technical problems and assist with the design of systems components or processes to meet specified needs. PO4 – “Engineering Tools, Experimentation & Testing”: Apply modern engineering tools and appropriate technique to conduct standard tests and measurements. PO5 – “Engineering Practices for society, Sustainability and Environment”: Apply appropriate technology in context of society, sustainability, environment and ethical practices. PO6 – “Project Management”: Use engineering management principles individually, as a team member or a leader to manage projects and effectively communicate about well-defined engineering activities. PO7 – “Life-long learning solution”: Ability to analyze individual needs and engage in updating in the context of technological changes. Facilities – Lab – Classrooms – High Speed Internet
